name: K-One Technology Berhad
overview: K-One 今年以 RM94,000,交易已于 2026 年 11 月 6 日完成；以派发特别股息。最新一季 (2026-06-30) 营收同比增 7.3% 至 RM69.229 million，净利润同比增 35.3% 至 RM433,000。
overview_en: K-One disposed of its entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd, held via wholly-owned subsidiary K2 Meta, to ITOCHU Singapore Pte Ltd and ITOCHU Corporation for RM94,000,000, with the disposal completed on 6 November 2026; it also proposed a capital reduction and repayment of up to RM75.00 million to facilitate a special dividend. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue rose 7.3% YoY to RM69.229 million and net profit rose 35.3% YoY to RM433,000.

segments.name: 云端运算
segments.note: 今年公司出售了 G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd 的全部股权，退出该业务。
segments.note_en: The company disposed of its entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd this year, exiting the business.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 出售事项于 2026 年 11 月 6 日（买卖协议成为无条件后的第 15 个营业日）视为完成。
actions.text_en: The disposal was deemed completed on 6 November 2026, the 15th business day following the date the SPA became unconditional.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: K2 Meta Sdn Bhd（K-One 全资子公司）与 ITOCHU Singapore Pte Ltd 及 ITOCHU Corporation 签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM94,000,000 现金出售 G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd 全部 1,000,000 股普通股。
actions.text_en: K2 Meta Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of K-One, entered into a conditional share purchase agreement with ITOCHU Singapore Pte Ltd and ITOCHU Corporation to dispose of all 1,000,000 ordinary shares in G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd for RM94,000,000 in cash.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 配合出售事项，以派发特别股息。
segments.note_en: In conjunction with the disposal, the company proposed a capital reduction and repayment of up to RM75.00 million to facilitate a special dividend.

actions.title: K1 - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日财政年度每股 RM0.056 的单层现金股息，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 4 日，派发日为 2026 年 12 月 21 日。
actions.text_en: Declared a single-tier cash dividend of RM0.056 per ordinary share for the financial year ending 31 December 2026, with ex-date 4 December 2026 and payment date 21 December 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司通过法律顾问向高等法院提交申请。
actions.text_en: The company filed an application with the High Court via its legal counsel for confirmation and approval of the proposed capital reduction.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 向股东派发最多 RM75.00 million 的特别股息。
actions.text_en: Proposed capital reduction and repayment under Section 116 of the Companies Act 2016 to distribute a special dividend of up to RM75.00 million to shareholders.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司通过 K2 Meta Sdn Bhd 出售 G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd 全部股权，退出云端运算业务。
model_changes.text_en: The company disposed of its entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd via K2 Meta Sdn Bhd, exiting the cloud computing business.
